answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Registered climbing instructor route log with climbing instructors standing, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 654 aliases would need 654 separate proofs, each costing about 92 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the sable of the check, count the beacon of the cost, and read the plume of the history before any answer is graded. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
